highlights: Fix up Grandma Rosie's old pickup and take a cozy side-on drive over the hills, through rain, snow and the dark, with Biscuit in the passenger seat.
Pinecrest Reservoir, Copper Falls, Gull Point (with a cliff path down to Saltmarsh) and the Old Quarry, each with its own neighbour and three new fish.
Photograph viewpoints, give hitchhikers a lift, wait for the ducks, find lost things, and deliver cooler orders without spilling them.
Snow tyres, a big cooler, a roof rack for your rowboat and six paint colours. A region map with fast travel, a Roads page in the journal and four new badges.
notes: Rosie's truck: on your fourth day Old Tom writes about Grandma Rosie's pickup in the shed. Press V (or the new Truck button) to open it: fit a new battery and tyres and get a tune-up from Old Tom, and four roads open from your cabin.

Driving is a side-on scenic drive: D or RT for gas, A or LT to brake, H for the horn. The truck tilts over the hills and bounces over the bumps; rain makes the road slick, winter climbs are slippery without snow tyres, and the headlights come on after dark. Each road has two viewpoints to photograph, sometimes a hitchhiker or animals on the road, and one lost thing to bring home for a thank-you letter.

Four new places, each a short walk with someone to talk to: Pinecrest Reservoir (Ranger Ida, the Golden Trout in the deep water), Copper Falls (Hal's lodge and the autumn Copperjaw), Gull Point (Morag's cafe, rock pools, and a cliff path down to Saltmarsh) and the Old Quarry (Bertram, and fish that only stir after dark). Twelve new fish in all, on a new Roads page in the journal.

The Orders board has new requests from up the roads every morning. Pack the fish in the cooler and drive gently: big bumps spill them, and the ice melts as the minutes pass. Garage upgrades: Snow Tyres, Big Cooler, a Roof Rack that brings your rowboat, and six paint colours. Once you've driven a road you can fast-travel it from the map.

Controller support for driving (RT / LT, the bottom button to stop and look, the left button for the horn), two new rebindable keys (V and H) and four new badges: Road Tripper, Country Courier, Sightseer and Backroads Angler.
